params.name: key
params.description: Your unique API key obtained after registering an account.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response. Available fields: countryCode, countryName, zoneName, gmtOffset, dst, timestamp. Defaults to: countryCode, countryName, zoneName, gmtOffset, timestamp.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter results by nation.

params.name: zone
params.description: Timezone name to filter results. Supports asterisk (*) wildcard. Example: "America/*" returns all American timezones.

items.docs: List out all available time zones supported by TimezoneDB. Optionally filter by country code or timezone name pattern. Supports field selection to customize the response payload.

params.name: key
params.description: Your unique API key obtained after registering an account.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response.

params.name: by
params.description: The lookup method to use. One of: - zone: Look up by timezone name or abbreviation - position: Look up by latitude/longitude coordinates - city: Look up by city name and country code - ip: Look up by IP address

params.name: zone
params.description: Time zone name or abbreviation. Required when by=zone. Example: "America/Chicago" or "CDT".

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude coordinate in decimal degrees. Required when by=position. Range: -90 to 90.

params.name: lng
params.description: Longitude coordinate in decimal degrees. Required when by=position. Range: -180 to 180.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Required when by=city.

params.name: region
params.description: US region/state code for additional filtering when by=city.

params.name: city
params.description: City name. Required when by=city. Supports wildcard (*) pattern matching.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for paginated results when multiple cities match.

params.name: time
params.description: Unix timestamp in UTC to retrieve timezone information for a specific point in time. Defaults to current UTC time.

items.docs: Retrieve local time, GMT offset, and DST information for a location. Lookup can be performed by timezone name or abbreviation, geographic coordinates (lat/lng), city name (with country), or IP address.
